description: Take-home pay for an employee in France from a gross yearly salary in EUR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026 barème with quotient familial and its cap; Joint taxation for married/PACS couples; Décote at low tax amounts; Employee contributions by PASS tranche, CSG/CRDS, APEC for cadres, mutuelle; Impatriate regime (30% flat exemption); Employer contributions (full rates).

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in EUR, without bonus

impat.description: Impatriate regime (recruited from abroad). Flat 30% of pay exempt from income tax for up to 8 years. Default false.

isolated.description: Raising children alone (parent isolé). Unmarried with children living with you: one extra half-part. Default true.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final), 2024 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in France (2026)
